projects.title: CLI Coding Agent
projects.content: Repository: https://github.com/hangtiancheng/yukino-code; a lightweight CLI Coding Agent; 5-layer architecture supporting multiple LLM providers; AI-friendly toolset; based on the ReAct paradigm, driving the LLM to autonomously complete coding tasks through alternating reasoning and action in an Agent Loop; System Prompt assembly; 5-layer permission system; MCP support; secure, high-quality context compression; instruction files, session persistence, and LLM automatic memory extraction with periodic memory consolidation; support for Slash Commands, Skills, Hooks; implemented worktree file isolation, predefined/fork Subagents, and multi-teammate Agent Teams; added support for image content blocks

projects.title: Frontend Monitoring & Event Tracking
projects.content: Repository: https://github.com/hangtiancheng/yukino-sentry; a framework-agnostic frontend monitoring SDK with publish-subscribe architecture; core module (event bus, lifecycle, data reporting) decoupled from plugin submodules (performance collection, screen recording); supports error capture, blank screen detection, performance metrics collection, and fault scene replay; error capture covers: resource loading errors, JSErrors, uncaught Promise errors, XHR and fetch request errors, with error deduplication and LRU queue support; supports declarative attribute-based click event tracing, hashchange and history navigation listening; blank screen detection via keypoint sampling; performance collection plugin computes metrics such as LCP/FCP/CLS/INP/TTFB, uses MutationObserver + rAF to calculate FSP first-screen render time and detect long tasks; screen recording with rrweb + gzip for fault scene replay; data reporting uses 3-tier fallback: navigator.sendBeacon -> Image beacon (optional) -> fetch keepalive; offline storage via localStorage with automatic queue flush on network recovery; provides React16+/Vue3+ framework integrations

research: Research focus: reinforcement learning-assisted computer network congestion control, multi-core parallelized network simulation
